features.name: v1_zscore
features.description: Standardized V1 using training mean and std for smooth linear projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a centered, scaled amplitude coefficient suitable for SVM margins.

features.name: v2_zscore
features.description: Standardized V2 using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized coefficient input for linear SVM.

features.name: v3_zscore
features.description: Standardized V3 using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Centered scaled feature for stable linear margin computation.

features.name: v4_zscore
features.description: Standardized V4 using training mean and std.

features.name: v5_zscore
features.description: Standardized V5 using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized high-order coefficient with comparable scale.

features.name: low_high_energy_ratio
features.description: Ratio-like contrast between low-order and high-order coefficients via log1p-normalized magnitudes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures spectral tilt as a smooth linear projection axis.

features.name: coef_decay_slope
features.description: Approximate linear slope across coefficient index using simple finite-difference average.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes a directional trend that linear SVMs can weight directly.

features.name: coef_curvature
features.description: Second-difference style curvature measure across coefficients.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a curvature axis orthogonal to slope, helpful for linear margin.

features.name: coef_l2_magnitude
features.description: Overall magnitude of the coefficient vector (sqrt of squared sum).

features.name: v1_v3_interaction
features.description: Centered interaction between V1 and V3 capturing joint deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear SVM an explicit interaction axis it cannot derive itself.

features.name: weighted_spectral_composite
features.description: Index-weighted composite emphasizing higher-order coefficients to summarize spectral position.
features.expected_model_benefit: A smooth weighted projection that aligns with possible linear separator direction.

features.name: nasal_vs_oral_resonance
features.description: Semantic estimate of nasal-like vs oral-like resonance pattern: high positive when low-order coefficients dominate over high-order ones (suggesting nasal-like spectral concentration), negative when high-order coefficients dominate (oral-like). Computed as scaled difference of normalized low vs high coefficient magnitudes, clipped to [-1, 1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes domain-informed phonetic resonance contrast as a smooth bounded score suitable for linear margins.
